mainEntity.name: How does AI Search Content Strategy differ from traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Traditional SEO primarily focuses on ranking for keywords in search results pages, often through on-page optimization, backlinks, and technical SEO. AI Search Content Strategy for AEO, while incorporating these elements, goes further by optimizing content specifically for AI algorithms and answer engines. It emphasizes semantic understanding, structured data, entity recognition, and providing direct, concise answers to complex questions, rather than just driving clicks to a website. The goal is to be the authoritative source from which AI draws its information.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI Search Content Strategy optimizes for AI algorithms and answer engines by focusing on semantic understanding and direct answers, unlike traditional SEO which primarily targets keyword rankings.
